pages.text: The Catalyst is the first component of a crystal farm: it consumes Akaishi Energy to make Geodes produce clusters.$(br2)$(bold)Four tiers$(reset) (range side / success chance / energy per tick):$(li)Basic: 3x3x3, 20%, 5 E/t$(li)Medium: 5x5x5, 30%, 25 E/t$(li)Advanced: 9x9x9, 40%, 125 E/t$(li)Ultimate: 16x16x16, 50%, 625 E/t$(br2)Higher tiers are more effective but consume more energy. Power must be supplied before operation.

Clusters grow only next to Akaishi Crystal Geodes. Geodes have four grades: Flawed → Normal → Pristine → Perfect; higher grades grow faster.$(br2)$(bold)Catalyst behavior:$(reset) each tick, every Geode in range receives one growth attempt; the resulting Akaishi Crystal Clusters drop 1-2 Akaishi Essence when broken.$(br2)$(bold)Geode upgrades:$(reset) the $(l:akaishi:aggregator)Energy Aggregator$(/l) upgrades a Geode by one grade for 10M energy.
Geode and crystal sources are covered in $(l:akaishi:crystal)Crystal & Essence$(/l). For an automatic crystal farm, see the $(l:akaishi:collector)Auto Collector$(/l).
